# package gds

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/gds"
```

Package gds manages the certificates of an OPC UA server by the push model of OPC UA Part 12 §7: a client with the SecurityAdmin role reads and writes the trust list of the server (the TrustList file of a certificate group, Part 12 §7.8.2), asks the server for a certificate signing request (CreateSigningRequest), installs the certificate a CA issued for it (UpdateCertificate), reads the certificates the server rejected (GetRejectedList) and makes the changes take effect (ApplyChanges).

It works with any server that implements the ServerConfiguration object (Part 12 §7.10.3): this module's server with server.WithPushManagement, open62541 built with UA\_ENABLE\_GDS\_PUSHMANAGEMENT, UA-.NETStandard and node-opcua. Part 12 requires a session with the SecurityAdmin role over a SignAndEncrypt channel; servers refuse the methods otherwise.

Beyond the methods of Part 12 1.04 it calls GetCertificates, CreateSelfSignedCertificate, DeleteCertificate and ResetToServerDefaults (Part 12 1.05 §7.10) and reads the TransactionDiagnostics. CertificateGroups lists the certificate groups of a server, the default ones and those of the application; their trust lists, like those of the DefaultHttpsGroup and the DefaultUserTokenGroup, are reached with WithTrustList. A private key for UpdateCertificate may be PEM or PFX (uapolicy.EncodePFX).

PullClient is the client of the pull model (Part 12 §6 and §7.9): it registers an application with a Global Discovery Server, asks it for a certificate (StartSigningRequest, StartNewKeyPairRequest), waits for it (FinishRequest), reads the trust list and checks revocation. Enroll does all of it, and an Enrollment configures an opcua.Client or a server.Server. Package gdsserver is the server side.

### func DecodePrivateKey

```go
func DecodePrivateKey(format string, data []byte, password string) (crypto.Signer, error)
```

DecodePrivateKey decodes the private key FinishRequest returned for a StartNewKeyPairRequest: format PEM (PKCS #8, PKCS #1 or SEC 1, or an "ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY" with PBES2, PBKDF2 and AES-CBC, decrypted with the password) or PFX (PKCS #12 protected with the password, see uapolicy.ParsePFX; its certificates are ignored).

DecodeTrustList decodes the content of a TrustList file.

### func EncodeApplicationRecord

```go
func EncodeApplicationRecord(ns uint16, r *ApplicationRecord) (*ua.ExtensionObject, error)
```

EncodeApplicationRecord returns r as the ExtensionObject of an ApplicationRecordDataType in the binary encoding, for a server whose GDS namespace has the index ns.

### func EncodePrivateKey

```go
func EncodePrivateKey(format string, key crypto.Signer, password string) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodePrivateKey encodes a private key as FinishRequest returns it: with format PEM a PKCS #8 "PRIVATE KEY" PEM block, or with a password an "ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY" (PKCS #8 with PBES2: PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA-256 and AES-256-CBC, RFC 8018). A PFX holds the certificate too: encode it with uapolicy.EncodePFX.

### func EncodeTrustList

```go
func EncodeTrustList(tl *ua.TrustListDataType) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeTrustList returns the content of a TrustList file: the TrustListDataType in the OPC UA Binary encoding (Part 12 §7.8.2.1).

### func NewCertificateRequest

```go
func NewCertificateRequest(key crypto.Signer, applicationURI, subject string, hosts []string) ([]byte, error)
```

NewCertificateRequest returns a PKCS #10 request for StartSigningRequest: the key of the application with its ApplicationUri, the subject (name value pairs separated by '/' or ',', or empty for CN=the host of the URI) and the host names and IP addresses. The key may be of any certificate type: RSA, ECDSA (NIST and Brainpool curves), Ed25519 or Ed448 (uapolicy.CreateCertificateRequest).

### func Thumbprint

```go
func Thumbprint(cert []byte) string
```

Thumbprint returns the thumbprint of a DER certificate as RemoveCertificate takes it: the SHA-1 of the certificate in upper-case hexadecimal. Part 12 §7.8.2.6 does not fix the case; UA-.NETStandard compares it case-sensitively with upper-case thumbprints, the go-opcua, open62541 and node-opcua servers accept either.

Its encoding NodeId lies in the GDS namespace, whose index differs from server to server, so the type is not registered with package ua: use EncodeApplicationRecord and DecodeApplicationRecord with the namespace index of the server.

#### func (Client) DeleteCertificate

```go
func (g *Client) DeleteCertificate(ctx context.Context, group, certType *ua.NodeID) error
```

DeleteCertificate has the server delete the certificate of a type of a certificate group (nil: the DefaultApplicationGroup) when the changes are applied (DeleteCertificate, Part 12 1.05 §7.10); certType nil is a null NodeId. A server refuses it with Bad\_InvalidState if the group has no certificate of the type, and ApplyChanges fails with Bad\_InvalidState for a certificate one of its endpoints uses. Deleting a certificate and then creating or updating one of the type in the same transaction replaces it, which servers that refuse to overwrite a certificate require.

### type EnrollRequest

```go
type EnrollRequest struct {
	// Record registers the application when ApplicationID is nil and no
	// application with its ApplicationUri is registered (registering needs
	// the DiscoveryAdmin role).
	Record        *ApplicationRecord
	ApplicationID *ua.NodeID

	CertificateGroup *ua.NodeID
	CertificateType  *ua.NodeID

	// Key, if set, is the key the certificate is for: Enroll sends a
	// StartSigningRequest with a request NewCertificateRequest makes.
	// Otherwise the GDS generates the key (StartNewKeyPairRequest).
	Key         crypto.Signer
	SubjectName string
	DomainNames []string

	// PrivateKeyFormat (PrivateKeyFormatPEM or PrivateKeyFormatPFX) and
	// PrivateKeyPassword are those of the key the GDS generates (no Key):
	// the format the key travels in.
	PrivateKeyFormat   string
	PrivateKeyPassword string

	// PollInterval is the interval of WaitForCertificate.
	PollInterval time.Duration
}
```

EnrollRequest is the input of Enroll.

```go
	MaxRecordsToReturn uint32 // 0: no limit
	ApplicationName    string
	ApplicationURI     string
	ProductURI         string
	ServerCapabilities []string
}
```

ServerQuery is the filter of QueryServers (Part 12 §6.6.9).

### type ServerQueryResult

```go
type ServerQueryResult struct {
	LastCounterResetTime time.Time
	Servers              []*ua.ServerOnNetwork
}
```

ServerQueryResult is the result of QueryServers.

### type SigningRequest

```go
type SigningRequest struct {
	// CertificateGroup is the certificate group (nil: the
	// DefaultApplicationGroup).
	CertificateGroup *ua.NodeID
	// CertificateType is the type of the certificate to replace, for
	// example RsaSha256ApplicationCertificateType (nil: a null NodeId,
	// which some servers take as their first certificate).
	CertificateType *ua.NodeID
	// SubjectName is the subject of the request, as X.500 name value pairs
	// separated by '/' ("CN=App/O=Company"); empty keeps the subject of the
	// current certificate.
	SubjectName string
	// RegeneratePrivateKey asks the server for a new key.
	RegeneratePrivateKey bool
	// Nonce is the entropy for the new key (at least 32 bytes); nil with
	// RegeneratePrivateKey generates 32 random bytes.
	Nonce []byte
}
```

SigningRequest is the input of CreateSigningRequest (Part 12 §7.10.7).

### type TransactionDiagnostics

```go
type TransactionDiagnostics struct {
	StartTime, EndTime        time.Time
	Result                    ua.StatusCode
	AffectedTrustLists        []*ua.NodeID
	AffectedCertificateGroups []*ua.NodeID
	Errors                    []*ua.TransactionErrorType
}
```

TransactionDiagnostics are the diagnostics of the last transaction of the server, or of the one in progress (TransactionDiagnosticsType, Part 12 §7.10.11).
